markdownPreviewUltra.scrollSync.description: Two-way scroll sync between the editor and the preview.

markdownPreviewUltra.lockPreviewGroup.description: Lock the editor group the side preview opens in, so newly-opened files land in the main group instead of replacing the preview.

markdownPreviewUltra.defaultMode.description: View mode used when opening a preview without an explicit placement.

markdownPreviewUltra.breaks.description: Render a single newline inside a paragraph as a line break.

markdownPreviewUltra.linkify.description: Automatically turn bare URLs into clickable links.

markdownPreviewUltra.typographer.description: Smart punctuation: curly quotes, dashes, and ellipses.

markdownPreviewUltra.html.enabled.description: Render raw HTML in the document (always sanitized). When disabled, raw HTML is shown escaped.

markdownPreviewUltra.math.enabled.description: Render LaTeX math expressions ($inline$ and $$display$$) via KaTeX.

markdownPreviewUltra.mermaid.enabled.description: Render ```mermaid fenced code blocks as diagrams.

markdownPreviewUltra.mermaid.theme.description: Mermaid diagram theme. `auto` follows the preview theme.

markdownPreviewUltra.frontmatter.display.description: How to show leading YAML frontmatter.

markdownPreviewUltra.theme.description: Preview theme. `auto` follows the VSCode color theme.

markdownPreviewUltra.customCss.description: Workspace-relative CSS files appended to the preview, in order.

markdownPreviewUltra.toc.visible.description: Show the table-of-contents sidebar by default.

markdownPreviewUltra.toc.width.description: Default width of the table-of-contents sidebar, in pixels. Drag its left edge in the preview to resize it (double-click the edge to reset).

markdownPreviewUltra.taskLists.toggleFro.description: Allow clicking task-list checkboxes in the preview to toggle `[ ]`/`[x]` in the source file. This is the extension's only write path; off by default.

markdownPreviewUltra.wikiLinks.enabled.description: Render `[[wiki links]]` as relative links (rendering only, no resolution).

scripts.package: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository
